description: This file provides a JavaScript module that defines functions to interact with a notifications API, including fetching notifications, liking a notification target, and commenting on a notification target. It uses external client functions get and post, and includes fallback stub data for development or offline scenarios.

methods.name: fetchNotifications({ page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of notifications for the current user, with optional pagination. Falls back to stub data if the network request fails.

methods.name: likeTarget(targetId, targetKind = "post")
methods.description: Triggers a 'like' interaction on a specific notification target, with fallback stub response for network failure.

methods.name: commentOnTarget(targetId, text, targetKind = "post")
methods.description: Triggers a 'comment' interaction on a specific notification target, with fallback stub response for network failure.

ctags.name: commentOnTarget
ctags.pattern: /^ export async function commentOnTarget(targetId, text, targetKind = "post") {$/

ctags.pattern: /^ export async function fetchNotifications({ page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = {}) {$/
